scope.canary_database_writes: Normal isolated-scope JEV claim/completion, shared quota accounting and bounded model-health projection only; no trade decision or order path

root_cause.verified: The deployed shared-Python -I child loaded jev_advisory.py by exact path, but its new symbols import could not resolve v2_core. Failure preceded client creation or provider requests.
root_cause.budget_health_gap: Local reserve availability was not a check of successful model responses. Model failure and budget exhaustion now have separate diagnostics.

behavior.isolated_imports: Exact-path pure symbols and advisory contract under a restricted synthetic package. No repository sys.path/PYTHONPATH insertion or real package initializer execution.
behavior.startup_proof: Exit 7 plus exact bounded schema jev-local-startup-failure-v1, whitelisted startup stage, and provider_request_started=false. A Popen OSError also proves no child request.
behavior.zero_usage: Only MODEL_LOCAL_STARTUP_UNAVAILABLE may reconcile integer zero. Unknown, timeout, ambiguous networking and existing configuration errors retain conservative accounting.
behavior.refund: CAS completion refunds only the original UTC+8 day reservation. Minute attempts remain counted; duplicate completion cannot refund twice.
behavior.entry_fallback: New typed startup failure follows the existing explicitly configured BASELINE/SKIP choice. Original risk and freshness checks, and model negative-opinion protections, remain authoritative.
behavior.health_projection: At most 20 completion outcomes in one fixed primary-key record, without prompt/account/symbol fields. Same coordinator lock, nested savepoint; failure cannot undo a completion or cause another model request.
behavior.health_defaults: 3 consecutive failures, or at least 3 recent completions in 30 minutes without success, produces JEV_MODEL_DEGRADED. Dedicated optional policy key changes diagnostic thresholds only.
behavior.health_reads: Two exact primary-key diagnostic reads under existing 100ms statement/50ms lock limits, savepoint-isolated from the valid budget read; no recent-request JSON scan.
behavior.health_recovery: Only a newer validated successful completion clears an incident. Missing data, no traffic, disabled policy and daily budget reset do not establish recovery.
behavior.notification: Existing TradingHealth detail provider, Watchdog notifier, private DM routing and delivery deduplication; strict typed fields and fixed Chinese reason mappings, no raw exceptions.

package.trading_health_packaging: Only new model-health import and notification whitelist were applied over the running file; pre-existing workspace quant health changes were not packaged.

diagnostic_retention.reason_for_addition: Bounding the current projection at 20 entries does not bound append-only history. The previously deployed retention policy did not cover this GLOBAL diagnostic identity.
diagnostic_retention.eligibility: Exact fixed StateKey UUID AND full six-field scope equality AND precise coordination reason AND health schema AND execution_authorized=false; only old nondeleted versions with an active current row, never S3-referenced history.
diagnostic_retention.preserved: Current snapshot/current history version, JEV request and budget records, other GLOBAL identities, trade/financial evidence, original diagnostic/demand/audit behavior, existing function OIDs/owners/ACLs and runner permission.
diagnostic_retention.schedule: Existing hourly maintenance function and dynamic policy; minimum 30-day diagnostic history, max 200 eligible health revisions per batch; current batch runner unchanged.
diagnostic_retention.performance_limit: Fixed identity with existing state_id/version index and original 5-second SQL timeout. LIMIT bounds deletion count, not the number of that identity's rows scanned when no expired revision matches. No global JSON scan or new index build was introduced.
